name: Chen Shuhong
current_role: Director, Red Star Macalline Group; acting-in-concert shareholder with founder Che Jianxing
profile: Chen Shuhong is linked to Red Star Macalline, the Shanghai-based home-furnishing mall operator founded by Che Jianxing. Company filings list her as a board director and as a person acting in concert with Che and Red Star Holdings. Her own business profile is very thin in public sources.
interesting_fact: Red Star Macalline's announcements name Chen Shuhong, together with Che Jianxing, as an acting-in-concert party of controlling shareholder Red Star Holdings, and she sat on the company's fourth board of directors.
notes: An unverified report (ctol.digital) calls her Che Jianxing's wife and says she handled shareholder duties while he was detained; no authoritative source confirmed this. Very private, and the group is in a sensitive period, with shares frozen by courts in 2025. Any approach should go through the company.
